mapper.sql: ref_id, owner_user_id, conversation_id, storage_key, format, duration_ms, expires_at, create_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM voice_ref WHERE ref_id = #{refId} AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW())
SELECT storage_key FROM voice_ref WHERE ref_id = #{refId} AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW()) LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM voice_ref WHERE ref_id = #{refId} AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW())
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO voice_ref ( ref_id, owner_user_id, conversation_id, storage_key, format, duration_ms, expires_at, create_time ) VALUES ( #{refId}, #{ownerUserId, typeHandler=com.echoes.voice.domain.voice.repository.typehandler.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{conversationId, typeHandler=com.echoes.voice.domain.voice.repository.typehandler.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{storageKey}, #{format}, #{durationMs}, #{expiresAt}, NOW() )
